material.title: UBC 公布冬季学期选课日期：6 月 24 日起分批开放
material.bodyOriginal: UBC's registrar published the winter session registration schedule. Registration opens on 24 June in year-level batches, the last day to add or drop a course without a fee is 8 July, and tuition for the term is due on 5 September. The notice lists the exact opening time for each year level and links to the student service centre.
